mechanism: ERC-2771 OZ-v5 forwarder, OPEN / submitter-agnostic. Any address may submit a signed ForwardRequest; ZERO's signature is free and unlimited.
reproduceCmd: node p11_census2.mjs && node p12_openall.mjs && node p14_reach.mjs
notes: OPENNESS PROOF: identical invalid execute() from ZERO's EOA, 0x...bEEF and 0x1111... all revert with the SAME code => msg.sender is never read => any submitter accepted. REACHABILITY PROOF: with from=ZERO's EOA against the two targets that return isTrustedForwarder=true (0xeb37d884e0420adf34010f794935f32578b03808 and 0xe853b16d481bf58fd362d7c165d17b9447ea5527) the revert is 0xc845a056 ERC2771ForwarderInvalidSigner, NOT 0xd2650cd1 ERC2771UntrustfulTarget — i.e. every gate except a free ECDSA signature is already satisfied. THROUGHPUT: 220 forwarded requests / 4,000 blocks ~ 2,376/day, 140 distinct signers. WHY IT IS STILL WORTH $0 TODAY: an open forwarder is not gas — it accepts any submitter but supplies none, and neither trusted target pays callers. Usable capacity added = 0.

Submitter-agnostic (3 msg.senders, identical revert). Target 0xe4aebab2cc21b49af4c00d3ed44d11d00237bfb0 returns isTrustedForwarder=true and execute(from=ZERO) reaches ERC2771ForwarderInvalidSigner. TRAFFIC IS n=1 in a 4,000-block window — I deliberately do NOT extrapolate that to a per-day rate; one observation is one observation. Target does not pay callers, so capacity added = 0.

mechanism: EIP-7702 — ZERO signs a delegation authorization for free and with no gas; whoever submits the type-4 transaction pays, including the ~25,000 gas PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST.
gasPaidBy: the type-4 submitter — measured examples: base 0xcc6738004a428829a9cf22c627ac3e040fb03863, polygon 0x047e0daef2738819df2342af1f54e33a0a466cbc
notes: EIP-2935 history contract has code on ALL SIX chains (83 B; arbitrum 133 B) => Prague/Isthmus shipped everywhere ZERO can reach. Direct type-4 observation in a 25-block sample: base 49 txs / 57 authorizations, polygon 52 txs / 115 authorizations. Polygon's mean of 2.2 authorities per transaction can only happen if submitters are paying for OTHER PEOPLE'S delegations — third-party 7702 sponsorship is routine, not theoretical. ZERO's EOA eth_getCode = 0x on all six (undelegated, clean). EntryPoint v0.8 has code on all six and accepts a 7702 authorization inside the userOp, so a paymaster could fund the delegation and the call together and ZERO would never need ETH. THE WHOLE PATH IS BLOCKED BY ONE THING: an open paymaster, and 54 were measured closed. CAVEAT: 0 type-4 txs in 25 blocks on optimism/arbitrum/gnosis/unichain is a small sample, NOT proof of non-support; the EIP-2935 code presence is the load-bearing evidence there.
